description: This Java test class, ExistsIT, is part of the persistence testing suite for the Eclipse Ditto project. It evaluates the existence queries for 'things' in a database based on various criteria such as feature IDs, attributes, and properties. The class extends an abstract base for persistence tests, sets up test data, and contains multiple test methods validating different existence scenarios.

classes.name: ExistsIT
classes.description: A JUnit test class for verifying the existence of Things based on various criteria within the database, implemented as part of Eclipse Ditto's persistence testing suite.

methods.name: createTestData
methods.description: Initializes test data in the database before each test case.

methods.name: existsByKnownFeatureId
methods.description: Tests for existence of a Thing with a specific feature ID.

methods.name: existsByKnownFeatureIdAndProperty
methods.description: Tests for existence of a Thing by feature ID and property.

methods.name: existsByExactAttribute
methods.description: Tests for existence of a Thing with an exact attribute path.

methods.name: existsByKnownAttribute
methods.description: Tests for existence of a Thing with a known attribute path.

methods.name: existsByUnknownAttribute
methods.description: Tests that no Things exist with an unknown attribute path.

methods.name: nullAndEmptyValuesExist
methods.description: Verifies existence checks when attributes have null or empty values.

methods.name: insertThings
methods.description: Creates and inserts test 'Thing' objects with specific attributes and features into the database.

methods.name: createAttributes
methods.description: Helper method for creating Attributes objects with a key-value pair.

methods.name: createFeatures
methods.description: Helper method for creating Features with a specified ID and property.

methods.name: createEmptyAttributes
methods.description: Creates Attributes with null or empty properties for testing.
